meta.task: R2 research: free chiptune/8-bit collections (MOD, XM, IT, S3M, VGM, NSF, FamiTracker), licenses CC0 / PD / CC-BY only
meta.method: WebSearch snippets only. WebFetch failed for all item pages (DNS ENOTFOUND for itch.io, modarchive.org, modland.com), so counts and licenses come from search snippets and are NOT verified on the source page. Entries with status to_verify must be checked before download.

status_legend.accepted: License CC0/PD/CC-BY stated in search snippet; still verify on the page before download
status_legend.to_verify: Possibly eligible, license or count not confirmed
status_legend.rejected: Fails license rule or no free license

meta.known_unique_tracks_note: Sum of counts that were stated in snippets for accepted entries; overlaps between OpenGameArt/itch.io packs (re-hosted and re-released tracks) are not removed. Unknown counts are null and not summed.

candidates.name: Big Mod Music Pack
candidates.license: Mixed: PD, CC0, CC BY per track (creator says NC and ND tracks were skipped). Check each track against the pack's MasterList.
candidates.attribution: Per track, from the uploader on The Mod Archive. CC BY tracks need the author credit.
candidates.format: MOD/XM/IT tracker modules (open with Schism or similar)
candidates.notes: Songs taken from The Mod Archive, pack dated Dec 2023, probably not updated. One snippet on a related pack lists CC BY-SA 4.0 too; CC BY-SA is not in the allowed list, so exclude any BY-SA track. Strongest tracker-format volume candidate.

candidates.name: The Mod Archive (site-wide, per-upload license)
candidates.license: Per upload: public domain or CC license if the uploader stated one. Not a blanket CC0 library.
candidates.attribution: Per upload, from the uploader's notes.
candidates.format: MOD, XM, IT, S3M and others
candidates.notes: Wikipedia says reuse needs the author's permission; AlternativeTo says private use only unless rights are granted. Can only be used track by track, checking each license on its page. Site could not be fetched, so no license filter was confirmed.

candidates.name: Vogons forum module pack (community compiled)
candidates.format: MOD, XM, S3M, IT, MTM, UMX, some RNS/XRNS
candidates.notes: Large, but no license stated. Rejected under the no-unclear-license rule unless the licenses of the individual files are confirmed.

candidates.name: Modland (mirror of tracker modules)
candidates.notes: Huge archive but no license. Most files are commercial game music. Rejected.

candidates.name: Exotica UnExoticA (Amiga game and demo soundtracks)

candidates.name: MODs Anthology (4-volume CD set, Internet Archive copies)

candidates.notes: Commercial CD product. Rejected unless the Internet Archive copy states a free license for each file.
